(B) Ownership Criteria: (a) The Tenderer should own Hybrid boat (Electric and Petrol) or Electric Boat for Mechanical removal of floating Waste/Trash from Flowing rive r (Not applicable to stagnant water) or ocean or sea or creeks etc. in In dia/overseas including its manning, operation and Maintenance. (C) Annual Turnover: The minimum average annual financial turnover of t he bidder during the last three years i.e. 2022-2023, 2023-2-24 and 2024-

2025, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be Rs.1. 97/- Crores. Documentary evidence in the form of Certified Audited Balan ce Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate containing UDIN number fro m the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover det ails for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. (D) Experience Criteria: The Tenderer (Excluding start-ups and MSEs) sha ll have successfully executed similar works with Government organization/ PSUs / or with any private organization in India/overseas during past 7 yea rs ending last day of month previous to the one in which applications are i nvited wherein the value of works shall be either of the following: (i) 3 similar completed works each costing not less than an amount equ al to Rs.2.22 Crores (Rupees Two Crores Twenty-Two Lakhs Only) (Ex cluding GST). OR (ii) 2 similar completed works each costing not less than an amount equ al to Rs.2.78/- Crores (Rupees Two Crores Seventy-Eight Lakhs Only) (Excluding GST). OR (iii) 1 similar completed work costing not less than an amount equal to R s.4.45/- Crores (Rupees Four Crores Forty-Five Lakhs only) (excluding GST). “Similar works” shall be defined as executing the contract for “Hiring of Hybrid Boat (Electric and Petrol/Diesel) or Electric Driven Boat or Petrol/Di esel Engine Driven Boat for Mechanical removal of floating Waste/Trash fr om ocean or sea or creeks in India/overseas including its manning, operati on and Maintenance” or “Mechanical collection. In case the financial figure and the value of completed works are in foreig n currency, the enhancement factors will not be applied. Instead, the forei gn currency will be converted into equivalent Indian Rupees (INR) at the State Bank of India BC selling rate or any other currency Exchange format/ platform as on the date of Tender submission (i.e. tender opening date). The Bidder shall submit the documentary evidence to show that they have executed the above works successfully & satisfactorily. In support of this, t he Bidder shall submit the copy/copies of order/s in full along with relevan t annexures/documents forming the part of the order or orders. In addition to this, the Bidder/Tenderer shall also enclose the copy/copies of the satisf actory performance certificate /satisfactory work completion certificates t o demonstrate completion of the corresponding order or orders under con sideration. TDS certificate is also applicable if work order executed with pr ivate organisation. mance Criteria as mentioned below shall be exclusively mandatory to MSE s and Start Ups. Organization Company. Proof of relevant experience and past performance. In addition, the technically qualifie d bidders shall conduct an operational demonstration of their vessel in JNPA Navigational cha nnel. The demonstration must be performed in the presence of JNPA Committee Members wit hin 15 days + 5 days of notification /intimation to the successful technical bidders. Subseque nt progression to the Price Bid opening phase of tender is strictly contingent, who successfull y clear the operational demonstration phase and approved from JNPA Committee Members. In case, if, technically qualifies bidders fails to perform successful Dem o of the Boat, Tender Committee will be at its discretion to disqualify s uch Bidder out rightly such bids will not be taken into account for furt her proceedings or for Price Bid opening.
